import re
text = hijri_date_iso.strip()
iso = re.fullmatch(r"(\d{1,4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})", text)
if not iso:
    # "2 Shawwal 1418", "Shawwal 2, 1418 AH", "2 Rabi al-Awwal 1440": the month by name, day and year as numbers
    nums = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r"\d+", text)]
    words = re.sub(r"\d+|\b[aA]\.?[hH]\.?(?![a-zA-Z])", " ", text)
    key = re.sub(r"[^a-z]", "", words.lower())
    months = {re.sub(r"[^a-z]", "", Hijri(1440, k, 1).month_name().lower()): k for k in range(1, 13)}
    months.update({"rabiulawwal": 3, "rabiawwal": 3, "rabii": 3, "rabiulakhir": 4, "rabiusani": 4, "rabiathani": 4,
                   "rabiii": 4, "rabialakhir": 4, "jumadaalawwal": 5, "jumadai": 5, "jumadalula": 5, "jumadaulula": 5,
                   "jumadaalthani": 6, "jumadaii": 6, "jumadalakhirah": 6, "jumadaalakhira": 6, "jumadalthani": 6,
                   "shaban": 8, "ramadhan": 9, "ramazan": 9, "dhulqadah": 11, "dhualqidah": 11, "dhulqidah": 11,
                   "zulqadah": 11, "dhulhijjah": 12, "dhualhijja": 12, "zulhijjah": 12})
    month = months.get(key)
    if month is None:
        found = [k for name, k in months.items() if key and (name.startswith(key) or key.startswith(name))]
        month = found[0] if len(set(found)) == 1 else None
    if month is None or len(nums) != 2:
        raise ValueError(f"date {hijri_date_iso!r}: give it as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 1418-10-02) or as day, month name "
                         f"and year (e.g. '2 Shawwal 1418'); months: " + ", ".join(Hijri(1440, k, 1).month_name() for k in range(1, 13)))
    day, year = (nums[0], nums[1]) if nums[1] > 31 else (nums[1], nums[0])
    hijri_date_iso = f"{year:04d}-{month:02d}-{day:02d}"
try:
    hijri = Hijri.fromisoformat(hijri_date_iso)
    gregorian = hijri.to_gregorian()
    return {
        "gregorian_date_iso": gregorian.isoformat(),
        "gregorian_year": gregorian.year,
        "gregorian_month": gregorian.month,
        "gregorian_day": gregorian.day,
        "display_date": gregorian.dmyformat()
    }
except Exception as e:
    raise ValueError(f"Invalid Hijri date: {e}")
